reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific new intervention (Ti doping) for the W38Ta36Cr15V11 alloy to suppress radiation-induced precipitation, a problem identified in P1/P4. While Ti is known for aiding sinterability (P10) and grain boundaries are known sinks, no passage combines Ti doping with this specific alloy to kinetically suppress precipitation via enhanced recombination and diffusion control, nor does any passage propose this as a solution to the precipitation issue. The mechanism linking Ti segregation to vacancy-interstitial recombination and slowed solute diffusion is a synthesis not stated in the literature.
